hypotheses.title: Idiosyncratic Risk Dislocation Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Stocks experiencing low trailing 30-day unsystematic variance relative to their 360-day baseline capture the low-idiosyncratic-volatility premium while avoiding severe firm-specific event risk.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms during severe systemic market liquidations.

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Spillover Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information propagates with friction through supply chains. Positive customer return shocks predict supplier performance with a 1-5 day lag due to delayed institutional updates.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns degrade when customer and supplier earnings reports coincide.

hypotheses.title: Options Put Breakeven Downside Support Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Stocks trading comfortably above open-interest weighted 30-day put breakeven levels have institutional gamma support, while those below face market-maker hedging headwinds.
confounders: Low options liquidity in illiquid names
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails when implied volatility crushes post-earnings.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_backfill((close - put_breakeven_30) / close, 20), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, subindustry)
